verdict: Organic activity is softening across all three brands; paid channels are dark.
narrative: In the last 28 days, all inbound activity across Forte Precision Metals, Advance Grinding Services, and O'Hare Precision Metals came exclusively from Google Business Profile — no paid campaigns ran on any brand. Combined, your three profiles generated 401 GBP actions this period, but all three saw sharp week-over-week declines (47–56%), and the most recent three days recorded zero actions on the Forte and AGS profiles. Search visibility is also thinning, with organic search clicks down week-over-week across entities, corroborating the GBP drop as a broader organic issue rather than isolated noise. Site reindexing is underway to restore impressions, and outreach sequences are being activated this month to open demand channels independent of search visibility — both are in motion ahead of the October 31 milestone.
